title: Maps from perfect complexes with support lift from an open to the ambient scheme

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Shift lift with support
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides Q on X supported on T with Q|_{U cap V} = P + P[1].

standard_prerequisites.name: Map lifting by tensoring with perfect complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: Replaces Q by Q tensor^L I to lift the composed map to E|_V.

standard_prerequisites.name: Gluing morphisms of complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: Assembles a: R -> E from the two local pieces.

core_obligations: Reduce to m = 1 by induction on the number of affines needed to cover X beyond U: X = U + V with V affine.
On U cap V the shift-lift input provides Q supported on T cap V with Q| = P + P[1].
By the map-lifting input, replace Q by Q tensor^L I (still supported on T cap V) so that Q| -> (P + P[1])| -> P| -> E| lifts to Q -> E|_V.
Glue by the Cohomology lemma: a: R -> E with a|_U = P + P[1] -> E|_U and a|_V = Q -> E|_V; R is perfect and supported on T, and P is a direct summand of R|_U compatible with alpha.
proof_roadmap: Induction to one affine; shift-lift on the intersection; map lifting with compatibility; gluing finish.
difficulty_reason: A reduction-plus-lifting argument built from two carded inputs and one gluing; short and complete.
